aggregation: Within each cohort, average dates within series x lead, then equally average series x lead. Weight electricity cohorts 1/6 each and cycle hire 1/2. Report per-cohort metrics and unweighted-case sensitivity.
rank: Ascending common-oracle cost-aware gap G_lambda; equivalent to loss + lambda*credits/B. No rounded-score ranking.
disclosure: Data and coefficient selected after exploratory results were available. This is not a blind or preregistered test. Previous July outcomes are retained without reselection; all 874 additional cases get fresh full-pool runs. No pilot best-of reuse.
